text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking through the campus, I 
spotted Mejiro Palmer talking with 
Katsuragi Ace.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
So can we run together tomorrow? Like, 
inject some of your fiery fighting spirit 
into me, Ace-san!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, leave it to me! Let's burn it up 
red-hot!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even after that—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Miracle, could I ask for a few more 
details about those body-care goods from 
the other day?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
They're super handy, ya know~. Made me 
wanna try out some other types too.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Of course. ...Is there anything specific 
you're curious about?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Umm, massage cream, support braces, 
athletic tape, and then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to Mejiro Palmer, she's 
usually the trusted advisor for other 
horse girls. I had thought she was relied 
upon far more often than the other way 
around.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, everyone's so sweet~. Lending a hand 
with a smile♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
—Oh! Could it be that you wanna help me 
out with something too?
choice_data_list: Huh? Ah, if you need help, of course.
Huh? Yeah, if you need help, of course.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hmm? ...You look kind of surprised?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I replied that I was surprised because I 
thought she was usually the one helping 
others out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I replied that I was surprised because I 
thought she was usually the one helping 
others out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You think? I rely on people quite a lot. 
There's tons of stuff that turns out way 
better when you collaborate, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Like, for example—oh yeah!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whatcha drinkin'? Whatcha eatin'? What are 
we singin'~~? Karaoke is literally my 
turf☆ Leave it all to me!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah, for real though, don't we want fried 
chicken first? Can I order it up?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, go for it! ...Fufu, you're so 
dependable♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
See, just like that. If someone's way 
better at something than you, it's smarter 
to let them take the wheel, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
If relying on each other makes things fun 
for everyone, then obviously the person 
being relied on is happy too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She considers both herself and those 
around her carefully. Her levelheaded 
approach is truly something to learn from.
choice_data_list: What do you plan to do next?
What can I help you with?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Let's see. I wanna take it easy today, so 
if I could get a little breather—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Bestie spottedddd☆ Hey, listen to this!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
That lip gloss you wanted the other day, 
Palm-chin? The shop by the station has it!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wanna bounce over right now? It's totally 
gonna look fire on you☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
For real? That info is a lifesaver~! Let's 
go, let's go~~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
See? Total win-win, right? —And on that 
note, see ya later~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Really?! Yay!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Then, well— Could you check this out for 
me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What she showed me was a golf video. It 
captured a magnificent hole-in-one, 
exhilarating just to watch.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: How was it? ...Come on, any thoughts?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Right?! So glad~~! I was looking for 
someone to share this excitement with!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, so satisfying! Thanks to you, I'll be 
in great spirits for the rest of the day. 
Thanks a bunch♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I didn't really do much of anything, but 
seeing Mejiro Palmer look so joyful 
brought a smile to my face too.
